client.answer: To order: buy your item from a Beltline shop, start an order on The Fast Roll, upload your receipt, set your dropoff spot, and confirm payment. A rider picks it up and delivers with photo proof.
You can order small, low-risk items: ice cream, snacks, flowers, small groceries, and similar Beltline-friendly items. No large furniture, no high-value electronics, no dangerous goods.
Delivery fees depend on distance and item type, but we keep it tight and Beltline-native. You’ll see the fee before confirming your order.
The receipt proves what you bought and the item value. Riders use it to confirm pickup and we use it to keep everything transparent.
We deliver to spots reachable from the Beltline — parks, benches, nearby addresses, and clear meeting points. The smoother the spot, the smoother the dropoff.

rider.answer: To become a rider: sign up on the rider page, add your PayPal email, set your preferred zone, and agree to the safety rules. Once approved, you can start accepting jobs.
Riders get paid via PayPal after each completed dropoff with photo proof. No long delays, just clean payouts.
Riders deliver small items: ice cream, snacks, flowers, small groceries, and similar Beltline-friendly goods. Light, safe, and smooth.
Riders follow Beltline-safe routes, avoid risky pickups, and always send pickup and dropoff photos. If a job feels off, they can skip it.
Each rider sets a preferred zone around the Beltline. Staying in a tight radius keeps jobs fast and efficient.

general.answer: The Fast Roll is a Beltline-native delivery service using skaters, longboarders, e-bikes, and OneWheels to move small items quickly and smoothly.
We operate along the Atlanta Beltline, focusing on spots directly connected to the trail and nearby meeting points.
For deeper issues, you’ll be able to reach support via the app or site. Scoot handles quick questions; humans handle complex problems.
